Logo.Heading: Store logo
Logo.Hint: The logo appears on the sign-in screen, in the sidebar and as the icon of every window and on the taskbar, on all tills. A square picture with a plain or transparent background works best. The desktop shortcut keeps the app's own icon (Windows reads it from the program file).
Logo.Saved: Logo updated. Other tills show it within a minute.

Shell.ShortcutsHelp:
Everywhere
  F1  this list
  Ctrl+F  go to the page's search box
  Esc  clear a search box / close a window
  F5  reload the page
  Ctrl+Shift+F  full screen on / off
  Ctrl + / Ctrl −  bigger / smaller text     Ctrl+0  normal size
  Enter  save in a window

Register
  F2  search products     F3  change the price     F4  customer
  F6  quantity     F7  line discount     F8  cart discount
  F9  hold sale     F10  resume held sale
  F11  online order     F12  pay
  + / −  quantity of the selected line     Delete  remove it

Search boxes find words in any order, Arabic spelling variants (أ/ا, ة/ه, ى/ي), Arabic digits and phone numbers however they are written.
